accessTiers.description: The current holder, travelling with possession rather than with an authorisation.
Persons with a legitimate interest, the Batteries Regulation Article 77(2) group generalised.
Notified bodies, market surveillance and other authorities.

title: General passport, version 1 (superseded)
description: Version 1 declared field names, labels, obligations and tiers only: no types, units, constraints or provenance. It is served for as long as any state declares it and describes those states plainly, not as better structured than they were.
regulatoryLine: A freeform product record; no regulatory mapping is claimed.

statements.text: Version 1 recorded no legal basis per field; its regulatory line was the whole of its claim.

stamps.description: The sample marker a demonstration record carries first; never product data.
The profile identifier the payload declares.
The profile version the payload declares; a reader decodes under it and never under a newer one.
An optional physical-object DID carried in the public payload; carrying it does not implement physical binding.
The data-carrier identifier (chip UID) the lookup service indexes beside the passport identifier.
